description: This file defines the Address controller class for the account section of an OpenCart-based e-commerce platform. It manages address-related functionalities such as displaying address lists, adding/editing addresses via forms, saving changes, and deleting addresses. It interacts with models for address data, handles user authentication, session management, and rendering views for address management.

classes.name: Address
classes.description: Controller class for managing user address book within the account section of OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the address list page, ensuring user is logged in and loading necessary layout components.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the address list request, ensuring user authentication and returning the address list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of addresses for the current customer and renders the address list view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the address creation/edit form, populating fields with existing data if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and saves a new or edited address; responds with JSON indicating success or errors.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an address after validation; responds with JSON status.
